query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple latest iPhone buy official Apple Store iPhone 2026
queries: Apple latest iPhone buy official Apple Store iPhone 2026

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone directly from **Apple** in the U.S.:

- **Apple Online Store:** Apple’s current iPhone buying page lists the **iPhone 17 Pro / iPhone 17 Pro Max** starting from **$1099**, with carrier trade-in deals available. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/goto/buy_iphone?utm_source=openai))  
- **Apple Store app** or a **local Apple Store** for pickup, delivery, setup help, and trade-in options.
- **Major carriers:** Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile usually sell the latest iPhones with installment and trade-in promotions.
- **Authorized retailers:** Best Buy, Costco, Target, and Walmart may also carry current iPhone models, though stock and unlocked availability vary.

If you want the safest option, buy from **Apple.com** or an **Apple Store**, especially if you want an unlocked phone, Apple trade-in, or help setting it up.
